rules.when: The task's primary deliverable is high-value ideation, narrative or video concept direction, workflow design, KPI or metric-system design, architecture choice, or a decision where the quality of the reasoning materially changes the direction of later work.
rules.why: Reserve ChatGPT Plus Codex capacity for decisions and designs whose quality affects substantial downstream work. End this stage with a concise durable brief for execution.

rules.when: The task requires a difficult root-cause investigation, a risky or broad multi-file implementation, a major refactor, a long dependent execution chain, or GLM-5.3-Flash has twice reproduced the same failure with no meaningful reduction in uncertainty and the evidence indicates a reasoning or implementation capability limit.
rules.why: Use the flagship Coding Plan model only when task complexity or observed evidence justifies its higher quota consumption.

rules.when: The task is low-risk summarization, classification, formatting, candidate generation, file or asset inventory, simple extraction, or another mechanical transformation whose output is cheaply sampled or deterministically checked.
rules.why: Use the verified free text model for bounded mechanical work with inexpensive validation.
